description: Header file for FreeType's outline processing functions and types, including creation, transformation, rendering, and orientation analysis of glyph outlines.

methods.name: FT_Outline_Decompose
methods.description: Decomposes an outline into segments and Bézier arcs, emitting path operations via callback functions.

methods.name: FT_Outline_New
methods.description: Creates a new outline with specified maximum points and contours.

methods.name: FT_Outline_Done
methods.description: Destroys an outline created with FT_Outline_New.

methods.name: FT_Outline_Check
methods.description: Checks the integrity of an outline descriptor.

methods.name: FT_Outline_Get_CBox
methods.description: Returns the control box of an outline, enclosing all points including Bézier control points.

methods.name: FT_Outline_Translate
methods.description: Applies a translation offset to an outline.

methods.name: FT_Outline_Copy
methods.description: Copies an outline into another outline.

methods.name: FT_Outline_Transform
methods.description: Applies a 2x2 transformation matrix to an outline.

methods.name: FT_Outline_Embolden
methods.description: Embosses an outline, increasing its thickness by a specified strength.

methods.name: FT_Outline_EmboldenXY
methods.description: Embosses an outline with different x and y strengths.

methods.name: FT_Outline_Reverse
methods.description: Reverses the drawing direction of an outline.

methods.name: FT_Outline_Get_Bitmap
methods.description: Renders an outline into a bitmap.

methods.name: FT_Outline_Render
methods.description: Renders an outline into a bitmap using the current scan-convert.

methods.name: FT_Outline_Get_Orientation
methods.description: Analyzes an outline to determine its fill orientation (clockwise or counter-clockwise).
